# Notification Sounds

This directory contains notification sounds for the application.

## Required Files

- `success.mp3` - Success notification sound
- `error.mp3` - Error notification sound  
- `info.mp3` - Info notification sound

## Usage

The sounds are used in the application for:
- Coupon application success/failure
- General notifications
- User feedback

## File Format

- Format: MP3
- Duration: 1-2 seconds
- Volume: Moderate (not too loud)
- Quality: 128kbps or higher

## Fallback

If sound files are not available, the application will continue to work without audio feedback.
